Box Fin Mount on RTH Frame

Attach the 20965 Frame Extender. Fix the 9700791 Channel and 9700792 Mount Clip to the frame before window install. Fabricate the Box Fin Shroud, then clip-install to the window frame. Screw fix up through the reveal, through the 9700790 mount angle, and into the timber building framing.

BOX Fin to RTH Window Connection

Cross-section: 9700791 Box Fin Channel Connector, 20965 Frame Extender, 9700790 Box Fin Angle Connector, 9700792 Box Fin Mount. Screw up through the reveal, through the hole in the angle and into the building framing — the screws may need cutting down to suit the building framing.
